project_info.theme: Galaxy S26 Ultra angled hardware hero poster
project_info.color_palette: Lavender gray, deep graphite, black lenses, white typography

main_subject.detail: Cinematic horizontal hero render of the Galaxy S26 Ultra viewed from an elevated rear corner angle with visible S Pen, centered product lockup, and a smooth lavender-to-charcoal gradient background.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic flagship hardware hero render, premium Samsung launch aesthetic

items: Top Left: Small white legal note 'Samsung account login is required for certain AI features.'
Top Right: Centered white lockup 'Galaxy S26 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI'.
Bottom Left: Soft dark gradient fading into the device corner.
Bottom Right: Large cropped camera-lens cluster and side profile of the phone with the black S Pen entering from the lower-left edge of the device.
Center/Background: Wide cinematic hardware crop against a smooth lavender-gray gradient with no additional clutter.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy lens reflections, subtle metallic edge highlights, soft cinematic gradient atmosphere

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy S26 Ultra angled hardware hero poster. Centerpiece is a cinematic cropped rear-corner view of the Galaxy S26 Ultra with large black camera lenses and a visible black S Pen against a lavender-gray gradient background. Background is smooth and uncluttered. Surrounding elements: centered white lockup 'Galaxy S26 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI', plus the small legal note 'Samsung account login is required for certain AI features.' at upper left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, glossy lens reflections and soft metallic highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
